name: app-shater-craftsman-onboarding-password-and-location-screens-grid
title: Shater craftsman onboarding grid: OTP, password reset, country picker and saved-location map screens
whatItIs: A grid of ten phone screens: phone-verification OTP, password reset with strength rules, a signup form, a country-code picker, a language picker, saved wallet locations with edit options, a live map pinning 'Mansoura', a location-permission prompt, and a service-request form with location and rating filters.
whatItMeans: Careful and secure; the explicit password rules and location permissions show attention to real-world account safety.
techniques: State password rules directly on the reset screen.
Ask for location permission with a friendly illustration before using it.
Let saved locations be edited or set as default.

vocabulary.definition: Stated requirements for a valid password.
A screen asking for access to a device feature.
